subject: Story pitch — the Colorado River reservoirs' record lows, in data
body:
Hi,

I'm writing from Talaix (talaix.com), a climate-extreme intelligence platform using satellite Earth observation and open data.

Carbon Brief reported on 17 August that Lake Mead and Lake Powell — the two largest US reservoirs — both hit record lows this month, affecting water supply for roughly 40 million people and 5.5m acres of farmland.

Talaix can prepare drought and exposure analysis for the Colorado Basin: soil-moisture trends, irrigated-agriculture and hydropower exposure, with sources and uncertainty stated.

Happy to brief a reporter or send a short pitch.

Best,
[اسم المرسل]

subject: Story suggestion — physical climate risk, from litigation to disclosure
body:
Hi,

I'm writing from Talaix (talaix.com), a climate-extreme intelligence platform built on satellite Earth observation and open data.

Most screens still lack source-labelled hazard and exposure data.

We can prepare a technical briefing on what verifiable physical-risk data looks like today.
